entities.name: Gods' Hall
entities.description: Grand structure now lodged in the roots of the World Tree in Istfell, once in the Gods' Realm.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: Realm of spirits on Kaldheim where the Gods' Hall now stands.

entities.name: Gods' Realm
entities.description: Original location of the Hall of the Skoti.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Tree in whose roots the Gods' Hall is lodged.

entities.name: Valki
entities.description: Trickster god who tricked his brother Toralf.

entities.name: Toralf
entities.description: Strongest son of the Skoti, tricked by Valki.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: Sensible god who warned Toralf of a trick.

entities.name: Windfell
entities.description: Wild spirit horse captured by Valki.

entities.name: Saga of Valki's Deceit
entities.description: The saga telling how the Gods' Hall came to Istfell.

events.summary: Valki shows Toralf and Halvar a godstone harness and claims he cannot tame the captured Windfell.
events.quote: He told Toralf and Halvar that he had captured the spirit horse Windfell

events.summary: Provoked by the word impossible, Toralf takes the harness and Windfell flees over the gate.
events.quote: At the word impossible, Toralf stood taller.

events.summary: Toralf chases Windfell for three days and harnesses him at the Gates of Istfell.
events.quote: For three days, Toralf pursued Windfell

events.summary: The harness triggers runic magic that pulls the Hall from the Gods' Realm into the roots of the World Tree; Valki has vanished.
events.quote: Toralf's mighty strength had triggered the runic magic, which pulled the Hall from the Gods' Realm to the bottom of the World Tree

events.summary: The gods' halfhearted efforts to move the Hall back are hindered by magic seeping from the World Tree.
events.quote: The gods keep saying they should move it back to the Gods' Realm

relations.quote: The Gods' Hall is a grand structure located in the realm of Istfell on the plane of Kaldheim .
When Toralf asked his brother what troubled him
in which Valki tricked Toralf into triggering runic magic
